notes.title: Il Sole e la Luna - Updating
notes.content: In the last update of “[b]Il Sole e la Luna[/b]” various quests were implemented, bug fixes were fixed and the monsters in life battle bar was introduced.  Stay up to date for any news and for the arrival of the second chapter of the saga!  [b]UNGame Productor[/b]
